threat_model.threat_source: AIs used by multiple nations to automate their defense systems; the harm is triggered by an error
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: A catastrophic error triggering a spiral of attacks and counter-attacks (a flash war) that happens too quickly for humans to step in
threat_model.capability: AIs are used to automate nations' defense systems
threat_model.access: Deployment within multiple nations' defense systems (AIs used to automate them)
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: The scenario is conditional on multiple nations using AIs to automate their defense systems; the spiral of attacks and counter-attacks would happen too quickly for humans to step in
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Human capacity to step in (intervene), precluded by the speed of the attacks; the multiple nations caught in the spiral of attacks and counter-attacks (a flash war)
